name: The Ocean Suite
summary: A top-floor suite with wraparound sea views and its own terrace.
description: Sitting on the top floor of Ocean Exmouth right on the seafront, the Ocean Suite pairs a large open floor with a run of glass doors onto its own terrace, so guests can spill outside for sunset views over the bay. It is set up for larger, more formal events — full wedding breakfasts, milestone birthdays, awards dinners — with an in-house bar and catering team who can build a menu around your event.
